lines.zh: 悬刺在低空滑行，翅膀轻摇。
lines.en: Hover Stinger glides low, wings sway gently.
It flies past, gaze sharp.

lines.zh: 悬刺紧贴地面飞行，搜寻猎物。
lines.en: Hover Stinger skims the ground, hunting prey.

lines.zh: 它的翅膀拍打着空气，发出细微声响。
lines.en: Its wings rustle the air softly.

lines.zh: 悬刺在毒刺中穿梭，寻找机会。
lines.en: Hover Stinger weaves through spikes, seeking chances.

lines.zh: 它沿着草地飞行，寻找目标。
lines.en: It flies over the grass, searching for targets.

lines.zh: 悬刺低空飞过，翅膀轻轻拍打。
lines.en: Hover Stinger glides low, wings tapping lightly.

lines.zh: 它俯冲向地面，准备攻击。
lines.en: It dives towards the ground, ready to strike.

lines.zh: 悬刺在花丛中穿行，寻找猎物。
lines.en: Hover Stinger weaves through flowers, seeking prey.

lines.zh: 它的飞行姿态优美，宛如舞蹈。
lines.en: Its flight is graceful, like a dance.

lines.zh: 两对翅膀空振，仍贴地挪动。
lines.en: Both wing pairs whirr, yet I still crawl low.

lines.zh: 翅膜太薄，撑不起这身毒躯。
lines.en: My wing membranes are too thin for this venomous bulk.

lines.zh: 毒刺朝前，我一步步逼近。
lines.en: Stinger forward, I close in a step at a time.

lines.zh: 蜂巢的气味在前，我循味而去。
lines.en: The hive's scent leads; I follow it.

lines.zh: 肮脏的珍珠在巢中，我急着回去。
lines.en: A filthy pearl lies in the hive; I hurry back.

lines.zh: 蜂后一唤，我便离巢巡行。
lines.en: One call from the queen and I leave the hive to patrol.

lines.zh: 悬刺静静地栖息，等待时机。
lines.en: Hover Stinger rests quietly, waiting for opportunities.
It hangs silently near the hive.

lines.zh: 悬刺静止不动，专心思考。
lines.en: Hover Stinger remains still, focusing deeply.

lines.zh: 它静静地漂浮，准备攻击。
lines.en: It floats silently, ready to attack.

lines.zh: 悬刺在空中悬浮，静待命令。
lines.en: Hover Stinger hovers in the air, waiting for orders.

lines.zh: 它静静悬浮，准备迎接挑战。
lines.en: It hovers quietly, ready to face challenges.

lines.zh: 悬刺平静地漂浮，等待指令。
lines.en: Hover Stinger floats calmly, awaiting instructions.

lines.zh: 它静静地驻留，等待时机。
lines.en: It stays quietly, waiting for the right moment.

lines.zh: 悬刺在空中停滞，静观风云。
lines.en: It pauses in the air, watching the events.

lines.zh: 它静静地栖息，耐心等待。
lines.en: It rests quietly, patiently waiting.

lines.zh: 停在地面不动，两对翅收拢。
lines.en: I rest on the ground, both wing pairs folded.
I guard the pearl without moving.

lines.zh: 悬刺注视着玩家，眼神锐利。
lines.en: Hover Stinger stares at the player, gaze sharp.
It fixes on the player, ready to attack.

lines.zh: 悬刺锁定玩家，准备一击致命。
lines.en: Hover Stinger locks on the player, ready to strike.

lines.zh: 它盯着玩家，准备发出毒刺。
lines.en: It focuses on the player, ready to sting.

lines.zh: 悬刺凝视着玩家，等待机会。
lines.en: Hover Stinger gazes at the player, waiting for an opening.

lines.zh: 它盯着玩家，准备发动攻击。
lines.en: It stares at the player, ready to attack.

lines.zh: 悬刺盯紧玩家，等待时机。
lines.en: Hover Stinger watches the player, waiting for an opportunity.

lines.zh: 它凝视着玩家，准备行动。
lines.en: It fixes on the player, ready to act.

lines.zh: 悬刺注视玩家，准备进攻。
lines.en: Hover Stinger looks at the player, ready to attack.

lines.zh: 它盯着玩家，准备释放毒刺。
lines.en: It focuses on the player, ready to sting.

lines.zh: 翅根被打断，我差点落地。
lines.en: My wing base is broken; I nearly fall.
Stinger damaged!
I slam down onto the stone.

lines.zh: 雷声过后，我的毒刺发麻。
lines.en: After the thunder, my stinger goes numb.
In the void!
Dirty pearl!
Fell into water!

lines.zh: 箭从侧面穿进我的胸节。
lines.en: An arrow pierces my thorax from the side.
A hole is torn in my wing membrane!

lines.zh: 珍珠还在巢里，我不能倒。
lines.en: The pearl is still in the hive; I cannot fall.
You get close, I sting!
I don't like your smell.

lines.zh: 我被你吸引，但不能碰我。
lines.en: You attract me, but don't touch me.
You move, I get angry.

lines.zh: 别靠近我，否则会有后果。
lines.en: Stay away, or there'll be consequences.
I'm poisonous, stay away.
You look at me, I'm warning you.

lines.zh: 我的毒刺会要了你的命。
lines.en: My sting will kill you.
I need space.
Move and I'll bite you.
You撞上me, it hurts!
Don't touch me, I'll retaliate.
You撞飞了me, I'm angry.

lines.zh: 两对翅膀也飞不起来，别撞。
lines.en: Two pairs of wings, yet I can't fly — don't shove.
You撞我, I warn you.
You撞上me, I'll sting you.
My sting will regret it.
You撞我, I'll attack you.
Don't touch me, it hurts!
You撞上me, be careful.
I'm the Queen, come on.
I'm the Queen's mate.
I'm called to mate by the Queen.
It's mating time now.

lines.zh: 蜂后产卵时，我守在巢门。
lines.en: While the queen lays, I guard the hive gate.
I'm the Queen's guardian.
Our offspring will be strong.
We are natural selection.
The Queen chose me.
I must mate now.

lines.zh: 肮脏的珍珠闪烁着阴森的光芒。
lines.en: Dirty pearls glint with an eerie light.

lines.zh: 珍珠沾满了毒刺的口水。
lines.en: Pearls are covered in poison.
Hover Stinger views the pearl as treasure.

lines.zh: 珍珠是毒刺的唯一食物。
lines.en: Pearl is the only food for Hover Stinger.
Hover Stinger buries the pearl underground.

lines.zh: 肮脏的珍珠让毒刺很兴奋。
lines.en: Dirty pearls excite the Hover Stinger.
Hover Stinger digs near the pearl.

lines.zh: 珍珠是毒刺唯一的藏身之地。
lines.en: Pearl is the only hiding place for Hover Stinger.

lines.zh: 毒刺守护着它的珍珠宝藏。
lines.en: Hover Stinger guards its pearl treasure.

lines.zh: 毒刺的毒刺粘满珍珠的碎片。
lines.en: Hover Stinger's stinger is covered in pearl shards.
Hover Stinger tracks the queen's commands.
Hover Stinger locks onto prey.

lines.zh: 毒刺翅膀拍打，准备攻击。
lines.en: Hover Stinger flaps wings, ready to attack.
Hover Stinger prepares to sting the prey.

lines.zh: 毒刺翅膀振动，锁定目标。
lines.en: Hover Stinger's wings vibrate, locking onto the target.
Hover Stinger's stinger aims at the target.

lines.zh: 毒刺翅膀扇动，锁定目标。
lines.en: Hover Stinger's wings flap, locking onto the target.

lines.zh: 毒刺翅膀振动，追踪目标。
lines.en: Hover Stinger's wings vibrate, tracking the target.

lines.zh: 毒刺翅膀拍打，瞄准目标。
lines.en: Hover Stinger's wings flaps, aiming at the target.

lines.zh: 蜂后指明目标，毒刺对准你。
lines.en: The queen marks you; my stinger aims.

lines.zh: 毒刺的毒刺对着目标扎去。
lines.en: Hover Stinger's stinger aims at the target.
Hover Stinger's stinger pierces the target.
Hover Stinger's stinger stabs the prey.

lines.zh: 毒刺的毒刺扎入敌人的身体。
lines.en: Hover Stinger's stinger pierces the enemy.

lines.zh: 毒刺的毒刺扎入敌人的皮肤。
lines.en: Hover Stinger's stinger stabs the enemy's skin.

lines.zh: 毒刺的毒刺扎入猎物的心脏。
lines.en: Hover Stinger's stinger pierces the heart of the prey.

lines.zh: 毒刺的毒刺扎入敌人的要害。
lines.en: Hover Stinger's stinger stabs the enemy's vital spot.

lines.zh: 毒刺的毒刺扎入猎物的要害。
lines.en: Hover Stinger's stinger stabs the prey's vital spot.

lines.zh: 毒刺的毒刺刺入敌人的血肉。
lines.en: Hover Stinger's stinger pierces the enemy's flesh.

lines.zh: 两对翅膀急振，毒刺蓄满毒液。
lines.en: Wings whirring, my stinger brims with venom.
Swinging its sting at you!
Stinging fiercely!
Poison injected into your wound!
Close sting attack!
Poison seeping into your body!
Sting clinging to your skin!
Venom oozing from the sting!
Attacking your weak spot!
Stabbing into your muscle!
Sting deeply penetrating!
Summoned by the queen!
Flying into the hive!
Hunting prey!
Residing in the hive!
Waiting for the command!
Tracing the enemy!
Hive is my home!
Protecting the queen's command!
Following the queen's move!
Answering the queen's call!

lines.zh: 翅膀受伤了，被火烧的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: Wing hurt! — and the fire makes it worse.
Fall from height!

lines.zh: 毒刺受损，溺水的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: Stinger damaged! — and the drown makes it worse.

lines.zh: 被摔伤了，遭爆炸的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: Fallen and hurt! — and the explosion makes it worse.
Hit by arrow!
Hit by magic!

lines.zh: 被雷劈了，挨饿的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: Lightning hit! — and the starvation makes it worse.
Lightning hit!
In the void!
